narration.text: The axis sounds dry after warm-up. I am checking lubrication before I chase servo or ball-screw faults.
The metering line is wet at the fitting but the guideway is dry. That points to a leak, not a tuning problem.
Run a slow test move. Smooth travel and a thin even film confirm the lubrication circuit is working.

lesson.title: A dry slideway points to a way-lube delivery problem before a servo fault
lesson.body: Inspect the reservoir, metering line, fittings, and pump before changing servo tuning; repair, refill, prime, and verify a slow test move.
